Struggling Blackpool sack head coach Evatt
- Published
Blackpool have sacked head coach Ian Evatt after a year in charge following a run of one win and six defeats in their past 10 league games.
Evatt's final match was Saturday's 1-0 away defeat by fellow strugglers AFC Wimbledon, leaving the Tangerines immediately above the League One relegation zone.
That defeat, however, came after the 45-year-old said his squad had been decimated by a sickness bug during their trip to the capital.
In a statement, the club thanked Evatt for his efforts and said Steve Thompson will take charge for Saturday's game against Wigan Athletic.
- 'It's been horrific' - Evatt says sickness bug decimated Blackpool 
  - Published3 days ago
Blackpool appointed Evatt, who won promotion from League One and the Championship during seven years as a centre-back for the club, as Steve Bruce's successor in October 2025.
During a six-year playing career at Bloomfield Road, Evatt made over 250 appearances for the Seasiders - however he departs the club on his 45th birthday.
On arrival as a manager, a tally of 13 points from a possible 15 in December 2025 lifted them out of the relegation zone, although they lost 10 and won two of their next 15 matches in all competitions.
They finished the campaign strongly, with six wins in seven games as part of a sequence of one defeat in 13 between mid-March and the end of August, only to struggle again as this season continued.
Speaking after their defeat by Mansfield in October, Evatt said he had "a huge amount of confidence" in his ability because of his record.
Evatt guided Barrow to the 2019-20 National League title in his first managerial role, then won promotion from League One with Bolton Wanderers the following season.
Wanderers went on to lift the 2022-23 EFL Trophy and reached the third-tier play-offs in consecutive seasons under Evatt, losing in the final in his final full campaign in 2023-24.

בלאקפול פיטרה את המאמן איאן איוואט לאחר תקופה של שנה בתפקיד, בעקבות רצף של שישה הפסדים ועשרה משחקי ליגה שבהם רשמה הקבוצה ניצחון בודד בלבד. משחקו האחרון של איוואט היה ההפסד החוץ לאפס קונדיישן מול קבוצת תחתית אחרת, שהותיר את המועדון ממש מעל קו היריגה בליגה הראשונה.

איוואט, שחקן העבר של המועדון שמונה לתפקיד באוקטובר 2025 אחרי הצלחות בבארו ובבולטון וונדררס, שילם את מחיר המשבר המקצועי. הנהלת המועדון הודתה לו על פועלו וציינה כי סטיב תומפסון יתפוס את המושכות ויעמוד על הקווים במשחק הבא מול ויגאן אתלטיק.
